# Component lifecycle

Lifecycle: `candidate → incubating → stable → deprecated → retired`.

A component can be code, service, template, adapter, protocol, recipe, policy, or reference
implementation. Do not force all reusable knowledge into a library.

Promotion to `stable` requires a validated real implementation, automated tests, integration
documentation, explicit compatibility/limitations, provenance/license, no embedded sensitive data,
maintenance/versioning policy, and evidence stronger than a design claim.

Application evidence records status, result, fitness, adaptation level, effort, stability,
maintenance cost, evidence strength and reuse recommendation. Cross-project lessons may alter the
component recommendation, compatibility, integration recipe or version.
